name: 86409 · Kingman, AZ
findings: ZIP 86409 (Kingman) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86409 (Kingman) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 86409 (Kingman) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
